validator_notes: Every ACCEPT row was opened; quoted TM50 and Hill were read on the page. Algebraic identity: PMA^H/(TM50^H+PMA^H) == 1/(1+(PMA/TM50)^(-H)). Current engine constants.py compared. No invented numbers. Upreti 2016 and Farhan 2024 full tables remain unread (paywalled) — not accepted from memory.

rows.citation: Rhodin MM et al. Pediatr Nephrol. 2009;24:67-76.
rows.evidence: Opened PubMed 18846389 abstract: 'A sigmoid hyperbolic model described the nonlinear relationship between GFR maturation and PMA. ... Half of the adult value is reached at 47.7 post-menstrual weeks (95%CI 45.1-50.5), with a Hill coefficient of 3.40 (95%CI 3.03-3.80).' Same pair restated in Anderson & Holford DMPK 2009 (opened J-Stage PDF): 'TM50 47.7 (95%CI 45.1-50.5) weeks PMA and Hill coefficient of 3.4 (95%CI 3.0-3.8).'

rows.citation: Anderson BJ, Larsson P. Paediatr Anaesth. 2011;21:302-308.
rows.evidence: Opened PubMed 20704661 abstract: 'CL maturation, standardized to a 70-kg person was described using the Hill equation. Mature CL was 523 (CV 32%, 95%CI 469, 597) ml·min(-1)·70 kg(-1). The maturation half-time was 73.6 (95%CI 59.4, 80.0) weeks PMA and the Hill coefficient 3 (95%CI 2.2, 4.1).' Paper exists (PMID/DOI/title match). Current engine 55.4 / 1.83 was not printed on any page opened in this pass.

rows.citation: Anand KJS, Anderson BJ, Holford NHG et al. Br J Anaesth. 2008;101:680-689.
rows.evidence: Opened PMC2733178 full text Table 1: CLmat50 54.2 weeks (95% CI 50.3, 60.5); HillCL 3.92 (95% CI 3.25, 4.40). Methods: 'The relationship between postmenstrual age (PMA) and clearance was investigated using a sigmoidal Emax or Hill equation' with CLmat50 = PMA at 50% mature CL. Abstract: 'Clearance was 50% that of the mature value at 54.2 weeks PMA (CLmat50)'. Same pair quoted on opened PMC3018029 (Mahmood 2011): 'CLmat50 = 54.2 weeks, HillCL = 3.92'. Anderson DMPK 2009 Table 3 (opened PDF) reprints Anand separate-Hill 54.2 / 3.92 and a simultaneous re-fit 54.6 / 3.83. Current engine 88.3 / 1.90 was not printed for morphine CL; Anand Table 1 Tvol is 88.8 days (volume, not CL TM50).

rows.citation: Cristea S et al. AAPS J. 2021;23:65.
rows.units: published as weeks PNA, not PMA. Extract conversion 27.3+40=67.3 is arithmetic-correct only under a term-birth assumption that the paper does not write.
rows.evidence: Opened PMC8096729: 'CLint, OAT1,3, in vivo was found to reach half of the adult capacity at a PNA of 27.3 weeks (RSE of 28%), which is around 7 months. The rapid ontogeny of OAT1,3 was captured by a hill exponent of 1.17 (%RSE of 36%).' Eq. 6 is ont = COV^hill / (COV^hill + TM50^hill) with COV = postnatal age. Paper exists. Do not drop 67.3 weeks PMA into the engine: the published covariate is PNA; +40 PMA conversion is not written in the source; cohort is critically ill children 1 month–15 y.

rows.citation: Cheung KWK et al. Clin Pharmacol Ther. 2019;106:1083-1092.
rows.units: published as weeks PNA (quoted); +40 PMA conversion is extract-side, not written in Cheung HTML recovered here
rows.evidence: Opened PMC8096729 quoting Cheung: 'children reaching half of the adult values around 8 months of age (TM50 = 30.7 weeks [95% CI: 16.64–50.97]) and the steepness of the ontogeny slope given by a hill coefficient of 0.51 (95% CI: 0.35–0.71).' Opened Cheung PMC6777991: paper exists (PMID 31127606) and reports sigmoid ontogeny of OAT1/OAT3 protein, but the TM50/Hill pair was not recovered from the Cheung HTML (table/figure not fully extracted). Protein abundance ≠ clearance. Prefer Cristea in-vivo function if a single OAT key is ever added; still PNA-based.

rows.citation: Anderson BJ, Holford NHG. Drug Metab Pharmacokinet. 2009;24:25-36.
rows.evidence: Opened J-Stage PDF. Page 27 prints the engine Hill: MF = PMA^Hill / (TM50^Hill + PMA^Hill). Table 1: Maturation Hill coefficient 3.43 (3.19–3.96); TM50 (weeks) 52.2 (49.8–54.1). Table 3 separate-Hill: Hill paracetamol 3.43, TM50 52.2 weeks; simultaneous common-Hill re-fit TM50 50.1 / Hill 3.4. Text: paracetamol is 'cleared by glucuronide (UGT1A1, UGT1A6, UGT1A9) and sulphate conjugation'. Numbers are real; do not map onto ugt1a1.

rows.citation: Anderson BJ, Hannam JA. Paediatr Anaesth. 2019;29:1100-1106.
rows.evidence: Opened PubMed 31472084 abstract: 'Clearance maturation, standardized to a 70 kg person was described using the Hill equation. ... The maturation half-time was 36.8 (CV 9.2%, 95%CI 34.7, 40.9) weeks postmenstrual age and the Hill coefficient 11.5 (95%CI 8.1, 15).' Paper exists. Drug-level ibuprofen CL (CYP2C9-predominant mixed, genotype-sensitive), not an isoform curve. Do not treat as cyp2c9.

rows.citation: Allegaert K, Holford N, Anderson BJ et al. Clin Pharmacokinet. 2015;54:167-178 (TM50). Hill printed in Healy et al. Br J Clin Pharmacol. 2025;91:283-296, Table 5, fixed from Allegaert.
rows.evidence: Opened PubMed 25258277 abstract: 'A sigmoid maturation model was used... CLPM (TM50 39.8 weeks) and CLPO (TM50 39.1 weeks) displayed fast maturation' — Hill not in the abstract. Allegaert full text was not opened (Springer paywall). Opened PMC11773095 Healy 2024 Table 5 (values fixed from Allegaert): TM50 CLPM 39.8 weeks PMA, Hill coefficient CLPM 9; TM50 CLPO 39.1, Hill 6.76. Engine pair 40.0 / 1.0 is not printed. Genotype (PM/IM/EM/UM) dominates adult CYP2D6. Not promoted to ACCEPT because the primary full text was not opened.
